description: Landings and safety systems: five landing entrances (frames, centre-opening panels on hanger tracks, interlocks, closers, sills, fascia, hall stations with clickable call buttons, position indicators), the open landing control panel beside the L5 entrance (VVVF inverter with Hz display, contactors, main switch, manual brake release, ARD battery, terminal strip) with its cables to the machine, the overspeed governor with its rope, car-lever clamp and pit tension pulley, final limit switches, the positioning tape, and the pit (PU buffers, pit ladder, stop switch, travelling cable with its half-speed loop). Adds the --open audit pose. Depends on FEAT-002. Design source: plan.md sections 3, 4 (items 99-129), 5 (travelling-cable special case), 6.
steps: Read context.json and this file, then plan.md sections 3-6. Read FEAT-001/002 findings.

parts\landings.mjs (items 113-121), one group per floor f=1..5 at Lf: frame (jambs + header, x 178..184, opening y 39..119); two landing door panels in <g data-door="L{f}-l|L{f}-r"> inner groups on the shaft side (x 175.5..177.5); hanger track and hanger rollers; interlock (lock box, hook, contacts) at the header; door closer; aluminium sill on its support angle with its groove (a closed outline); fascia/toe guard on the shaft side; hall station plate on the jamb face (x=184, y 128..136) with ▲/▼ buttons (L1 ▲ only, L5 ▼ only) as face-plane groups carrying data-call="f" data-dir="up|down" role="button" aria-label; position indicator window above the door (x=184, y 70..90, Lf+214..226) with <text data-pi="f"> fitted to the widest string. Static items (piece 'landings', group 'landings').

parts\controller.mjs (items 122-129): the LCP cabinet {x:180,y:128,w:16,d:34} z 1240..1440 on the L5 lobby slab, its door open about 100° (G.prismOf on a rotated frame, hinge pins), internals: VVVF inverter with heatsink fins (closed slots) and a display window <text data-hz> (fits '00.0 Hz'), 3 contactors, main switch, brake release lever (G.sphereOf knob), ARD battery pack, terminal strip; cables via H.cable from the LCP into the shaft and up to the machine terminal box, the brake-release Bowden cable to brake A, and the encoder cable, each ending on a connector shell or terminal dot, routed along the structure (craft.md section 8 harness rules).

parts\safety.mjs (items 99-105): governor at (123,146,1520), R 10, plane x-z, on a bracket clamped to the y1 car rail, with flyweight housing, tripping switch and face group data-rot="gov"; governor rope as two static vertical tube runs at x 113 and 133 (y 146) plus wraps, closed through the tension pulley at (123,146,40) on a weighted pivot arm bracketed to the rail; the car's lever clamp (FEAT-002) grips the x=113 run, so check it with crowding (it is a fitting on that rope); final limit switches top and bottom on brackets on the y1 car rail (x 88..95) actuated by the car cam; positioning tape at (145,147) with top clamp plate (ruler strip with topTicks rooted on its edge) and pit spring tensioner.

parts\pit.mjs (items 106-112): car PU buffers at (100,24) and (100,132), r 7.5, tops at 81, on pedestals; CWT buffer at (80,191), top 65; pit ladder (x 170..180, y 145..180: stiles, rungs, brackets to the pit floor and the L1 slab edge); pit stop switch box near the ladder top; travelling cable: wall clamp on x0 at (14,50,830), fixed leg as H.ropeSlide-style slide (ride travel, move [0,0,560]), loop (tube arc, R 25, plane x=14, centre y 75, ride travel, move [0,0,560]), car leg = the plan.md section 5 special case (A.slide from the loop's rest tangent to the car hanger, ride travel, move [0,0,1120], drawn exactly with a clip shifted by loopOffset - carOffset in live.js; one owner for leg + loop; assert in layout.mjs that nothing else occupies that column), car hanger bracket on the car back.

build.mjs --open: with the flag, place car and L1 landing door panels at their open slide in the recorded shapes and the drawing (car at rest at L1), so the audit proves the open pose too. Write the page as usual (it can show the open pose) and do not change the default output without the flag.

info.mjs: add groups landings, hall, indicators, controller, governor, limits, tape, buffers, ladder, cable, pit, each with a true sentence (e.g. governor: Ø200, 95 rpm at 1.00 m/s, trips at 1.15 m/s and pulls the progressive safety gear).

live.js: the governor face rotates from govAngle, the travelling-cable loop translates at half speed (share * [0,0,560]), the car-leg clip shifts, and the landing door groups exist for FEAT-004 to drive (no dispatcher change needed yet).

Run both audits and lines in both themes. Shoot 4x close-ups of a landing entrance (lock, hanger, sill, hall station, indicator), the LCP, the governor and tension pulley, and the pit, in both themes, and read them.
acceptance_criteria: lines.mjs prints 'line ends: 0' on both themes at rest.

Every landing shows a hall station and a position indicator on its lobby face; the LCP is open with its internals visible; the travelling-cable loop is visibly lower when the car is at L1 and halfway up when the car is at L5 (capture with --key 5).
